caption: The local goat decided it was time for a change of scenery today, and the residents of the farmhouse didn't seem to mind one bit! They traded the garden paths for a high-altitude adventure. A five-star ride with excellent scenery and a very stoic, fuzzy chauffeur. 🐐✨
